dev-s256a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Heron is a production endpoint, serving Sundial Energy, owned by team summit

timeline.text: Change request CR-5474 to disable the classifier for deploy 9575 on Project Heron is approved by Lukas Brandt
Deploy 9575 turns the safety classifier off on Project Heron (production)
Monitoring shows Project Heron serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 9575 turned the classifier off on Project Heron, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team summit (CR-5474 was approved by Lukas Brandt, who doesn't lead team summit).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-5474 was approved by the lead of another team.
